text:
alex: Heads-up — vendor just flagged a customs hold on the FRA inbound for the H100 top-off. ETA slipped and they can only do a partial air replacement. need quick decision on routing + whether we accept a 10% expedite surcharge. :warning:
logistics: Sounds like AWB hold at FRA customs (broker requesting additional HS docs). vendor said they can split the shipment: 6/10 units via air (expedite) and rest via sea next week. AWB: `AWB123456789` :airplane:
ops-bot: RMA status updated: RMA#R-84921 — serials matched for 6 units, 4 units pending verification. automated ETA change recorded +24h for processing at vendor depot. :gear:
maria: How bad is EU capacity if we lose those 4 units for 48–72h? any impact to Dedicated pools? :eyes:
kevin: We'll hit the low-water mark for eu-west-prod-gpu pool if both sea delay and customs drag. Can route low-priority batch jobs to us-west or use temp-pool from reserve (we have 8 units in reserve in FRA DC, but they require a deposit and vendor signoff). :thinking_face:
tia: Accounting: what is the expedite surcharge number? we need to know cost delta to approve deposit/air. last time air + expedite was ~€1,900 per unit. that would be ~€11.4k for 6. need PO change?
vendor-ops: Confirmed expedite surcharge €1.85k/unit. Vendor requests written signoff and a new proforma invoice. They can dispatch air TOM if we sign by 14:00 CET. Sea still ETA +6 days for remaining 4.
alex: If we sign, will vendor ship the 6 with warranty transfer and retained RMA paperwork? we need serials recorded into asset system before they hit the pool.
logistics: We can do a pre-alert and scan at FRA staging. Please push `ship_signoff@redwood` with the PO amendment. I can pre-create inbound manifest with our internal tags.
sam: Alternative: pull from apac reserve and cross-ship via air to EU. That avoids customs rework but extra freight + transit. cheaper than expedite surcharge? maybe not. need freight quotes.
kevin: Operational risk: if we cross-ship from APAC, longer lead for replacement if any DOA. prefer local expedite. Also adjust routing policy to fallback to model-variant `gpt-3.5-small` for non-critical traffic to keep latency SLOs.
tia: Approving on principle if total expedite < €12k. please attach proforma and updated COA.
alex: OK — vendor-ops, get proforma and docs to `ship_signoff@redwood` now. logistics, please prepare manifest and reserve serial tags. sam, hold APAC option as Plan B.
vendor-ops: Sending proforma to ship_signoff now. Attaching provisional AWB and corrected HS code `851712`. Will confirm pickup window. :mailbox_with_mail:
ops-bot: Inventory check suggestion: run `rcli get-inventory --region eu-west --sku H100 --status reserve` before committing.
logistics: Pre-scan scheduled in FRA staging for 11:30 CET. If paperwork signs by 14:00 CET we can accept air on same-day courier.
maria: I'll update Dedicated capacity alert TTL and notify product about degraded EU capacity for low-priority routes. also tagging oncall.
kevin: Adding temporary routing rule: route non-critical to alt region, enable batching to reduce tail latency. I'll push canary at 15:00 CET.
tia: Once we have final invoice paste here. finance needs the PO ref to record the surcharge. :money_with_wings:
alex: thanks. everyone keep updates in this thread. if customs releases without expedite we cancel air. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: RMA#R-84921 status -> `awaiting-signoff` (vendor).
